visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed band of two equal photo tiles side by side, no gutter, stacking on mobile
visualCharacteristics.text: centered white text over each photo: small eyebrow, large uppercase title, circled-arrow CTA

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: image | text (eyebrow, heading, link)

reuseGuidance: Use for 1-2 edge-to-edge link tiles with centered text over a photo. Not for editorial teasers with text below the image (cards-teaser).
